import sys, random, json; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen, gentrace, para, algo, simulator
from refreplay import ref_replay
rng=random.Random(31337)
bad=0; n=0; statuses={}
for it in range(600):
    K=rng.randint(1,3)
    prof=gen.gen_profile(rng,K,consistent=True)
    cal=para.Calibration(prof)
    if not cal.feasible: continue
    fab=gen.gen_fabric(rng,K=K)
    tr=gentrace.gen_trace(rng,prof,fab)
    g=rng.choice(fab['guards_ns'])
    a=simulator.replay_exact(prof,fab,g,tr)
    b=ref_replay(prof,fab,g,tr)
    n+=1
    for s in a['send_status']: statuses[s]=statuses.get(s,0)+1
    if a!=b:
        bad+=1
        print('MISMATCH'); print(json.dumps(tr)); print(json.dumps(fab))
        for k in a:
            if a[k]!=b[k]: print(' key',k,'\n got',a[k],'\n ref',b[k])
        if bad>1: break
print('compared',n,'mismatches',bad)
print('status histogram', statuses)
